reviews.author: Fred Hamilton
reviews.text:
I had been putting off getting my wisdom teeth removed for several years, because I was always afraid of what the recovery time would be and how much it might hurt. I was pleasantly surprised in every way when I came to visit Dr. Myrhe at Austin Elite Smiles. I’m happy to report the only thing that was even mildly uncomfortable was the initial anesthetic injection, and even this was minimal. I attribute this largely to Dr. Myrhe’s attention to detail and depth of experience.

One of the many things I learned from him during my visit for my wisdom teeth extraction as well as at a later appointment for a crown, is that the anesthetic can sometimes be more uncomfortable as it’s administered, simply due to the fact that it’s stored at a temperature of at least 20°-25° less than your body temperature. Dr. Myrhe actually takes the time to warm it up before administering it, to reduce the amount of shock your tissue feels when it’s introduced. Seriously, like who do you know that goes to that level of detail to ensure patient comfort?

I wasn’t surprised to learn that he also uses a higher grade of anesthetic that last longer, and even works faster. This was great for me because I typically metabolize the medicine very quickly, and will need to stop midway during a procedure for more to be administered… this hasn’t happened at all during my visits.

The thing that impresses me the most is that Dr. Myrhe has always taken the time to patiently answer my many many questions about the procedures and what to expect during and afterwards…. And he’s totally fine with me asking my questions BEFORE the work starts, so I don’t have to talk with a mouth that’s still numb or while I’m biting on gauze, etc.

Sorry if any of this was more detail than you wanted to hear… but I think it’s important to know how much care you can expect from ALL of the staff at Austin Elite Smiles. I’ve visited for what’s considered pretty major work, but I’ve felt only a minor amount of discomfort and incredibly fast recovery times.

Most people associate a visit to the dentist with negative thoughts or emotions… but I don’t feel that way at all here! They are super welcoming, professional, knowledgeable, and most importantly, patient!

I highly recommend the entire team at Austin Elite Smiles for any of your dentistry needs. They take amazing care of their patients, and they do amazing work!

reviews.text:
I chose Define Dentistry because they were listed as in-network with my Ameritas insurance and it was family owned. Unfortunately, my experience with their billing and pricing transparency was very frustrating.

I was charged at my initial appointment even though my insurance provides 100% coverage for preventive services such as exams and cleanings. I was also quoted a price for a recommended procedure that was approximately three times higher than the contracted insurance amount with my insurance. When I asked for a breakdown of my expected out-of-pocket cost, I was told they could not tell me what I would owe until after the procedure was completed, I paid up front and the insurance claim was finalized.

I am a director of a clinic and know insurance very well and In my experience, most medical and dental offices can provide a reasonable estimate based on insurance benefits before treatment. Being asked to pay a large amount upfront and then receive a refund later if insurance covers more is not a practice I have encountered before, and it made it difficult to make an informed financial decision.

The staff was friendly, professional, and the office itself was clean and welcoming which is why I gave it a 3. My concern is not with the quality of the facility or the people working there, but with the lack of clear communication regarding costs and treatment plan estimates.

Dental care is expensive, and patients deserve very transparent information so they can understand their financial responsibility before committing to treatment. Asking for hundreds out of pocket and stating “amount will be adjusted once we receive the finalized claim from Ameritas after the extraction is done.” Is just not something I can get behind and it just doesn’t build trust.

I strongly recommend anyone coming to Daylight Dental to get a second opinion before agreeing to any treatment. I do not trust the reviews for this practice. I also do not like to leave bad reviews for any businesses specially a women owned ones. I switched my dentist after relocating to Austin and selected this office based on these reviews. Unfortunately, my experience was highly unsatisfactory.

The cleaning I received was the worst I have ever had. I was informed that I had two cavities, despite the fact that my previous dentist had identified no issues during years of routine checkups — including within the past six months. This discrepancy raised immediate concerns.

Unfortunately I trusted them. After two fillings were performed, I experienced persistent pain for several weeks. Following an extended evaluation, the office acknowledged that the filling had been placed improperly by Dr. Pham and too close to my tooth pulp (nerve). As a result, I was told I would now require a root canal — a procedure they were not even able to provide. The filling was also uneven and could be felt distinctly with a fingernail.

Also, when I reported noticeable buildup remained after the cleaning, the issue was attributed to “personal hygiene.” Additionally, I felt pressured to undergo a fluoride treatment, which I declined.

I strongly advise caution and recommend not solely relying on these reviews when choosing this practice. Do yourself a favor: save your money, time, and most importantly your health by seeking more professional practice.

The differentiator here is that my last office pressured me into treatments that I didn’t prefer. Whereas this current location offers the same option but is kind enough to help demonstrate better habits to mitigate the risk. No office is perfect, but the fact that the fluoride from my last office didn’t necessarily eliminate the cavities, I left without learning anything else about how to better care for my teeth. Whereas in the current office my teeth looked just the same as with any cleaning done before. Instead, I was informed of the basics in the normal look for teeth and how it should be able to function in spite of its colorization. The general public thinks of ‘cleaning’ as going all white but like I said before, my treatment from both office locations looked the same after. But learning the basics of how teeth function day to day helped me develop habits. I still hear that I get cavities but it is very much controlled for when I practice what was given. I think the general public forget that dental offices aren’t there to make your teeth last forever. They are there to help sustain a healthy life function for your teeth the same way a medical doctor is trying to sustain you for the rest of your life for the lifestyle you lead. Staff were clear on the insurance they take and super approachable people. My cleaning was done thoroughly and procedures for treatments were also made clear to me. I wish I had a better experience like the other reviews, but unfortunately that wasn't the case for me. I came in for painful sore gums and 2 cracked teeth that were very sore and painful that were on the top right of my mouth. My visit started okay with filling out paperwork and then after I got called back. The dental assistant started taking x-rays of my teeth. Even when I expressed that I had sore teeth and gums were sore she made me and me to bite down harder for the x-ray. This mad everything more painful. Then after that I was taken to another room. My experience only got worse from here.

I waited for the Dr. Pham to examine my x-rays. She found a lot of things wrong with me teeth. When she came to go over the x-rays she put the examination chair back and started poking at my teeth not even explaining what she was doing. Causing me more pain in sensitive areas and then proceeded to blow air on them irritating my mouth more. Not even bothering with walking me through what was going on. Then I did tell her that I had anxiety with people working on my teeth. She took that too literally and told me that she could only refer me out to a oral surgeon and that she wouldn't do the procedure of extracting teeth. I was in pain then and I am still in pain. I may have been calm during the appointment. But I have a strong pain tolerance.

I asked if she could offer a pain killer for my sore gums and teeth. She said no at first and said I could just get an over the counter medicine. I had to ask twice to just get some ibuprofen to stave-off the pain until I can get help me my teeth. She then proceeded to ask why I came to this dental office and not Happi Dental where I initially got my teeth worked on. I told her that I thought these offices were sister companies and thought it wouldn't matter.

She then asked if I went to the doctor regularly and pryed at asking me about  my medical history. In which was very invasive. I feel that she doesn't have very professional bedside manner. I told her I was getting frustrated that she wouldn't help me with my pain with my gums or teeth and wouldn't help me in house for the procedure that I needed. After that talked he just left the room abruptly with the assistant telling me that she could only help me with the referral. She left me there for a little while without any way to know what I should expect next. They left me waiting in the exam room for awhile. I didn't she Dr. Pham any time after that.

She ruined my experience and wasn't very professional. After all of this I am still in pain and only have a referral for a oral surgeon that I am waiting to hear back from. All in all, it was very disappointing. I don't recommend Dr. Pham based on how she treated me and I think she needs to work on being more sensitive to patients.

I would not recommend this clinic. My experience was very disappointing. I initially went in for a routine dental cleaning, but instead of performing the cleaning properly, they pressured me into getting an unnecessary filling. At my previous dental visit just six months earlier, my former dentist had found no issues with my teeth.

During my appointment, they did not actually perform a proper cleaning during my visit. It felt more like they were pretending to do the procedure rather than providing real care. I was extremely unsatisfied with the experience and really do not want to return to this clinic to ask them to complete the cleaning they were supposed to provide.

Unfortunately, my husband had a similar experience. He was also persuaded to get an unnecessary filling, which caused him significant pain for several weeks. After seeking further evaluation, we learned that the filling had been placed improperly and too close to the nerve. As a result, he now requires a root canal.

Based on my experience, it felt like their priority was not patient care, but charging for unnecessary treatments and taking advantage of patients. I do not recommend this clinic and will not be returning. If you are considering treatment here, I encourage you to think twice and do not trust on the high fake online ratings.

However, after my appointment (X-rays and evaluation), I was unexpectedly told that I had to pay $357 out of pocket upfront. This was never explained to me beforehand, and it felt very misleading. If I had been given accurate information from the beginning, I would have made a different decision.
The staff was polite, but that does not make up for the lack of transparency regarding costs and insurance handling. It is very important for a healthcare provider to be clear and honest with patients about financial responsibilities.

reviews.text:
I had such a great experience at ATX Family Dental! From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by how beautiful and welcoming the office was, and parking was super easy, which was a huge plus.

My hygienist, Dedee, was absolutely wonderful — so sweet, caring, patient, and attentive. She even had me feel my teeth afterward to make sure they felt smooth after all the cleaning procedures, which I really appreciated. As a new patient, she did an amazing job walking me through everything and making sure I understood what she was doing.

She was also fantastic during the X-rays. She gave me really helpful instructions, tips, and tricks so that the pieces I had to hold in my mouth wouldn't hurt or be uncomfortable. I especially appreciated that they had a sign on the window explaining how much radiation you experience from a single X-ray versus a full set. As someone who appreciates knowing what to expect, that was really reassuring and informative.

And the little extras made the experience even more fun — they have TVs on the ceiling with Netflix, complete with a remote and headphones! It was honestly such a fun experience to be able to watch something while getting my teeth cleaned. And getting a gold star for having NO CAVITIES was definitely the highlight! 😂⭐

My dentist, Amanda, was also incredibly sweet, professional, and caring. She took the time to walk me through all of my imaging, explain what she was seeing, and go over preventative care and treatment options in a way that was easy to understand. I never felt rushed or like I was being pressured into anything.

One of the things I appreciated most was that both my hygienist and Dr. Amanda remembered things I had written on my new-patient intake paperwork and brought them up during my visit so they could be considerate of them. That small detail really stood out to me because it showed that they actually took the time to read what I had written rather than treating me like just another appointment.

Overall, I had an excellent first experience here. Everyone was kind, thorough, professional, and genuinely caring. I’m so glad I found ATX Family Dental and would absolutely recommend them! 🦷✨

I have been a patient since 2020, and my experience with this practice has been nothing short of exceptional from day one.

My very first introduction to ATX Family Dental happened when I needed help for an emergency. They were able to fit my mother in for an urgent tooth extraction on a moment's notice. No other dental office would see us that quickly, but they stepped in with incredible helpfulness, compassion, and care during a stressful situation. Because of that unforgettable experience, I became a patient myself and have never looked back.

Since then, I have introduced my husband and other family members and friends to the practice, and they are now dedicated patients as well. Whenever someone asks for a recommendation, this is the only place I send them.

One of the most notable things about this practice is their punctuality. They send friendly reminder messages about upcoming visits, and they are always on time with appointments. I have never had to sit in the office for extended periods of time, it is always a seamless, punctual experience.

When I had more complicated dental needs requiring specialized care, Dr. Adam referred me to an absolute dream team consisting of a prosthodontist and an oral surgeon. I trust Dr. Adam’s professional expertise, and his referrals led to an amazing prosthodontist and oral surgeon who provided equally exceptional care as ATX Family Dental.

The new building is absolutely beautiful. Going there feels like a spa experience rather than a clinical office, it is warm, inviting, and wonderfully pleasant to be in. Additionally, the music they have playing in the office since I became a patient back in 2020 has always been awesome. If ATX Family Dental had a Spotify playlist, I'd follow it on Spotify!

An added fun bonus to the exceptional professionalism is that every room has a ceiling mounted television where you can watch any show you'd like (I can't recommend watching The Great British Bake Off enough!).

The entire team is exceptionally patient and always willing to answer all of my questions. I never feel rushed, and they provide thorough care along with very clear billing breakdowns that explain the cost of everything so there is never any confusion.

Dr. Adam is the best, and the other doctors I have seen at the practice are equally awesome. The hygienists, dentists, and entire office staff are consistently kind, professional, and compassionate. I cannot recommend the entire team of ATX Family Dental enough!

I found out I had been overcharged by this office on multiple occasions. For example, I once paid $130 at my appointment and was later billed an additional $150. Most recently, I was charged $50 when I checked in for a routine cleaning that my dental insurance indicated should have been covered with a $0 copay. (This was clarified that I was charged $49 for an irrigation cleaning AFTER I leave a negative review)
I also came in to have my permanent retainer repaired. Instead of correcting the bend, it was glued back in place at an angle.(The picture provided to me actually proves my permanent retainer is at an upward angle now.) During previous visits, I was repeatedly told by Dr. Amanda that I needed a cap on one of my teeth, but another dentist in the same office later told me that the tooth did not need a cap. (This was flat out denied and deflected to her saying my other crowns don't need replacement. That's not what I was speaking on and tells me a LOT. I read other negative reviews and unnecessary crowns seem to be an ongoing trend here.)
My most recent cleaning itself was very good, and the hygienist was friendly. The only issue was that the topical numbing gel wasn't given enough time to take effect before the Waterpik portion of the cleaning, which made that part quite painful. (Fully blamed the hygiene stuff instead of reflecting on why they feel the need to rush out and come in sick.)
Unfortunately, after several years of billing issues and inconsistent treatment recommendations, I've decided to find a different dental office. (Bethany's response made this final decision that much easier.)

reviews.text: ATX Family Dental, they have set the new standard. My expectations out of visiting a dentist have been radically changed. The folks here at ATX are the most caring dental professionals I've ever interacted with. I drove 8 hours just to see them, and I will continue to do so.

reviews.author: Harper Jackson
reviews.text:
The most caring and thorough family dental practice in Austin!
ATX Family Dental is an absolute standout and a practice that has completely transformed my family's experience of going to the dentist. From the very first appointment the entire team welcomed us with genuine warmth and made every member of our family feel completely comfortable and at ease regardless of their age or level of dental anxiety. The dentists are exceptionally skilled thorough and take the time to clearly explain every procedure and recommendation in a way that is easy to understand and truly reassuring. The office is beautifully modern impeccably clean and equipped with the latest dental technology which really inspires confidence in the quality of care being delivered. The scheduling is always smooth and efficient and the wait times are minimal. ATX Family Dental is without question the finest family dental practice in Austin and one I recommend wholeheartedly to every family in the city!

reviews.author: Ceyanna Smith
reviews.text: I must say this was the greatest experience I've ever had at the dentist. I'm usually very anxious and dread going but this time was very different. The hygienist Cailee was very friendly, made me feel at ease, and provided great recommendations. They even have a TV on the ceiling that you can watch while you're getting your teeth worked on. I would highly recommend for anyone that is looking for a new dental home. 5 GOLD STARS!!!!!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Fedell Price II
reviews.text:
I came in later in the afternoon as a same-day walk-in, and the team was incredibly accommodating. Dr. Adam was very helpful despite having a tight schedule and made time to see me, then quickly penciled me in for the next day without any issue.

Erika was especially insightful and helpful, keeping me informed on my options and making everything easy to understand. The front desk staff were also very patient and supportive throughout the process.

As someone new to Austin who hasn’t found a dedicated dentist yet, I really appreciated how smooth and welcoming everything felt. I think I may have found my new go-to for dental care.

reviews.author: Dr. Akua
reviews.text: I cannot give ATX Family Dental enough rave reviews. In my opinion, it’s hands down the best dental practice in town. I’ve been coming here for a couple years and have recommended them to many of my loved ones and colleagues. Everyone is super friendly and accommodating. The women at the front desk and in billing are the absolute best. They are warm and welcoming, and always go out of their way to listen and help. Dr. Adam is very personable and knows how to connect with his patients and truly see them. I know I’m in good hands with him and that I will receive exceptional care at fair prices. Dr. Amanda recently installed my dental implants and I love them. She carefully guided me through the entire process, patiently answering my many questions along the way. The dental hygienists consistently provide me with deep and thorough cleanings. I’ve had significant changes and improvements since I started coming here. Today, I came in for my professional whitening treatment and left with a million dollar smile. Kristen, you did your thing, girl. Thank you! I am in front of the camera a lot these days, so I’ve become even more particular about my smile. I’m grateful to have an entire dental team that I can count on. If you are looking for exceptional care in a warm and welcoming environment, give ATX Family Dental a call. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Zea
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at this dental office. I switched from another dentist and the vibes here are just that much more immaculate. Everyone I have talked to in the past 2 visits have been so lovely and kind from the receptionists, assistants, and doctors. Very inviting. I got my wisdom teeth extracted by Erica and Dr.Nadia. They were amazing and made the experience that much better. I recommend this office to anyone and everyone because they are just that awesome....shout out mom for putting me on🙌

reviews.author: Jonah
reviews.text:
The BEST in ATX!

ATX Family Dental has been absolutely amazing to me and my pearly whites.

Dr. Adam and Dr. Amanda have the most exceptional practice I’ve visited, including every hygienist and receptionist!

If you’re looking for the most welcoming, comfortable, professional and efficient dentist office in Austin… you’ve found it right here!

I have to give extra thanks and all of my gratitude to Dr. Amanda, Idalis, and Bethany for keeping my smile sparkling! (:

reviews.author: Jennifer Villanueva
reviews.text: My experience was great, everyone was pleasant from the moment I entered. I will continue to keep going.

reviews.author: Ben Carney
reviews.text: Super modern, highly professional, and tech-forward dentist office with great attention to the customer experience.

reviews.author: Jasmin Arrieta-Meraz
reviews.text: My sister kept on recommending this place to me for a while now and I finally caved in. I wish I had come sooner! Everyone is so nice and the place is very modern and clean. It legit makes me so excited for my next appointment. She’s gotten like 4 of us to come here! Totally recommend for you to come here. You can tell they really care about you! 🦷🪥

reviews.author: Meena Rancourt
reviews.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at ATX Family Dental. I’m typically a very nervous dental patient, but Sarah was absolutely amazing from start to finish. She was professional, kind, incredibly skilled, and made me feel completely at ease. Her attention to detail and gentle approach actually made the entire process enjoyable, something I never thought I’d say about a dental visit!

The office itself is beautiful and exceptionally clean, and the entire staff creates a welcoming, positive atmosphere the moment you walk in. Dr. Adam is attentive, thoughtful, and clearly cares about each of his patients’ comfort and experience.

Overall, a fantastic experience. I’m so grateful to have found a dental office that makes me feel comfortable and genuinely cared for. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Samantha Fox
reviews.text: They give you a literal, physical gold star for your checkup!? Hands down the best dentist I've been to, and I truly dread checkups and establishing new car. They took the time to genuinely understand my needs and goals for my first visit as a new patient, and even referenced several things I'd put in the notes during the introduction. They were incredibly understanding when I had a last-minute reschedule for my first visit. They took the time to thoroughly explain every step of the examination and cleaning, and then took time to really walk through the results in a way I could understand. There was never a rushed feeling, and they even had time to add on some preventative treatment I wanted. They also gave me honest insight about things like teeth whitening, even if it meant I wasn't going to ultimately give them business as a result / might use OTC options instead. When I wasn't watching the TV on the ceiling, I had an amazingly relaxing view out the window. The environment is calm and the team is so friendly, understanding, reassuring, and respectful. They even have laughing gas available in each room as needed. I LOVE that they avoid anything invasive if at all possible, explain treatment options without pressure, focus on prevention, use an Isolite (had never seen that before), and could even make my night guard using scanning technology instead of doing impressions. Highly, highly, highly recommend!

reviews.author: Paige Randall
reviews.text:
What an amazing experience! You can tell this place truly cares about their patients. The office is also so beautiful.

Both Dr. Nadia and the dental hygienist DeDee made me feel super comfortable.

I look forward to future appointments knowing that I am in good hands.

reviews.author: Elmer Cornett
reviews.text: I am very satisfied with the service at this dental clinic. The dentist is knowledgeable and very gentle during treatment. The clinic environment is clean, comfortable, and organized. The staff are friendly and helpful which makes the entire process smooth and stress free.

reviews.author: Amy Baker
reviews.text: Been here a few times. I can say they will communicate with you.. there’s a couple people here that seem very nice and then some that are just doing the job. Not for me; I prefer more “care” but not a bad place at all . Office is nice!!

reviews.author: Rahul Jakhmola
reviews.text: The staff is skilled, friendly and the facility feels really pleasant - and I look forward to my next visit every time. I would highly recommend ATX family dental if the location works for you.

reviews.author: Amanda Adams
reviews.text: They have wonderfully kind employees, especially Haley. I had a terrible experience with a previous dental practice and ATX Family Dental was such a breath of fresh air after that. While treatment options & estimates were provided, there was zero pressure and they took time to explain things in detail. Atmosphere is really cozy for a dentist office, which I’d imagine would be really helpful if you have anxiety around dental visits. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Armando Chapa
reviews.text: Best dental care place I've ever been to. They have amazing staff and their services are top tier. The facility is very nice, It not a normal dental office, it feels like I'm outside in nature.  I used to hate going to the dentist, but ATX Family Dental changed it for me, I feel so relaxed just walking in.  Would highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Dayna Williams
reviews.text: I never thought I would say this, but I enjoyed going to the dentist! Deedee did a terrific job as my hygienist and Dr. N was great. Thanks for a wonderful first visit.

reviews.author: Jazmin Arroyo
reviews.text: I cracked my tooth a few months ago and recently started experiencing pain. ATX Family Dental came in clutch and got me an appointment right away. Dr. Nadia and Fey were both incredibly kind and took the time to explain my options, which made me feel comfortable making a decision. Thank you to the whole team also, the new building is beautiful!

reviews.author: Lorrie Castellano
reviews.text: I always feel well cared for and my every comfort is taken into account.

reviews.author: Alexia LeMoine
reviews.text:
I was referred here for dental work after finishing my Invisalign treatment with Dr. Kunik, and I’m so glad I found them! I needed some bonding redone, and they have taken excellent care of me throughout the entire process.

I had a lot of questions along the way, and the team was always patient and never made me feel like a bother. Dr. Amanda did an amazing job. I had my two front teeth bonding redone (along with some other teeth), and they look fantastic. I feel so much more confident in my smile now!

I’ve been about four times in the span of three weeks, and every visit has felt like such an upscale experience. They go above and beyond with little touches like offering a blanket, providing access to streaming services, and even giving me a lavender-scented towel at my last appointment.

I’m so happy I found them and will likely be switching to them as my regular dentist. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Carl Hargreaves

reviews.text: First time customer. Very impressed with the staff and the overall style, design, music, demeanor; vibe.    First visit was empathetic and very clear instructions and plan of action.

reviews.author: Lily Kepner
reviews.text: I HATED the dentist and always avoided going, but when I had a tooth ache and came here they could not have been more amazing and patient. Now, I look forward to the dentist! Affordable and takes insurance too. I'm a fan!

reviews.author: Elijah Carpenter
reviews.text: ATX Family Dental has been amazing! I have had to get two crowns done recently. They work with my insurance & I am able to use their partner app Cherry to make payments(INTEREST FREE!). Dr Amanda has been SO kind and listens attentively to any questions or concerns I have before and during treatment. Also the professionalism and positive attitudes from the staff I’ve gotten to interact with Idalis, Erica, and Tien have made my time here feel calm and comfortable. I’ve always been scared of coming to the dentist but here I feel a bit more part of the family!

reviews.author: bbr devs
reviews.text: Amazing team! Dr A. Is incredible. Best practice in Austin. Latest tech. Wish all my doctors were like him and his staff. 10 *!!!

reviews.author: Cailee Banaszak
reviews.text: My hygienist Sarah and Dr Amanda took great care of me at my appointment this week! If you’re looking for a dentist that really cares & also puts your anxiety at ease, this is the spot!!

reviews.author: The Kogane (livhard)
reviews.text:
This is the one. You can stop looking for a new dentist now.

Here's my story:
I got tooth-lazy when the pandemic hit. I had a couple of root canals done pre-covid that ended up awaiting their crowns for farr too long post-covid. So long, in fact, that the dentist who did the root canals up and retired.
Avoidance at that point was way too easy and time just went flying by. Eventually one of those teeth chipped and all those warnings from my old dentist about the dangers of not crowning a tooth that's had the nerve/blood supply removed came flooding back. A friend recommended ATX Family Dental-and to this day that girl has not steered me wrong. Take her advice.

(Oh, and they have Netflix on the ceiling.)

reviews.author: H
reviews.text: I highly recommend ATX Family Dental. The team took great care of my teeth and my concerns. The entire practice showed a great deal of empathy and knowledge for what I needed resolved. I’m very grateful for their work!

reviews.author: Ani DeGroot
reviews.text: There’s a dentist office near our home but my husband and I both prefer to make the drive for ATX Family Dental—for us and for our baby. Great doctors, staff, amenities, parking.

reviews.author: Patrick Pace
reviews.text: Amazing team and experience!  I had a dental emergency, and the team re-worked their schedule to get my situation stabilized that day.  So appreciative!

reviews.author: Chris Galluccio
reviews.text: Dr Nadia and Thien and Angelica are amazing best dentist group i have ever been to!!!

reviews.author: Danielle Sunberg
reviews.text: My 2 kids loved their dentist appointment! They felt cared for and were entertained by tvs and stickers and toys. Dr Adam was fabulous with helping them feel confident about the whole process. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: K L
reviews.text:
ATX Family Dental's Wellness Plan saved me when I found out my employer's dental insurance wasn't accepted by any dental offices and my previous dentist kept pushing my appointment months out. I was able to sign up for the plan and be seen within 2 days of making the change.

When I arrived, parking was simple and the office was gorgeous! Everyone was so nice. Then I saw the technology. Ever had the goopy, nasty impressions on your teeth? ATX Family Dental said NO MORE! They have a machine that takes 1,000s of photos per second and builds a model of your mouth. They also had TVs on the ceiling so I got to watch Planet Earth while my teeth were cleaned. When I was done, they literally gave me a gold star sticker for taking care of my teeth. I'm an adult and I don't think we get NEARLY enough stickers anymore, so that was a very pleasant surprise!

I am happy to say that after feeling lost and forgotten with my previous dentist, I now LOVE my dentist! I have cancelled my insurance and will go to ATX Family Dental from now on!

Keep up the great work and see you in 6 months! :)

reviews.author: Anais Pegias
reviews.text:
I had my first visit at ATX Family Dental today for a filling after deciding to switch from my previous dental practice, which had been a really bad experience. I am so glad I made the change.

Amanda did an incredible job on my filling. She is extremely skilled, gentle, and made the whole process feel easy and smooth.

My assistant Kirsten was also wonderful and made me feel very relaxed throughout the appointment.

The whole team was professional and welcoming, and the experience was smooth from start to finish. I would absolutely recommend ATX Family Dental to anyone looking for a great dentist in Austin.

reviews.author: Ariel Morado
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my experience. Sarah was great and very trauma informed. I will definitely be referring folks, because good dentist offices are hard to find.

reviews.author: Mohammed Alberznji
reviews.text: Just happy with my decision to switch. They are very professional and detailed. They take time to keep you informed of your dental health in every step.

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.text: The staff is always great and very encouraging of even the smallest steps toward better dental health. I’ve never once been guilted even though I’m horrible about not flossing. They’re also great at helping come up with alternatives that work better for YOU (eg flossing is hard? Try a water pick once a week at first and work your way up).

reviews.author: Lauren Shabino
reviews.text: Such a great experience as always! I’ve gone to a few dentists in the 10 years I’ve lived in Austin and ATX Family Dental is hands down the best start to finish. Been going for years now- Highly recommend 🙂 …

reviews.author: Robyn Schoen
reviews.text: My husband and I have been patients of ATX Dental for several years now. The care we’ve  received from this facility has been fantastic! I appreciate their time and care when it comes to our dental health! Their new building is just icing on the cake! :) would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Byron Smith
reviews.text:
Excellent experience at ATX Family Dental. Sandy and Dr. Adam Gutwein were incredibly attentive, efficient, and welcoming. You can tell they truly care about their patients and take pride in what they do. The office is modern, clean, and very well run.

After searching around, I’ve officially found my dentist in Austin.

reviews.author: Stevie Golding
reviews.text: Always a great experience here! The doctors and hygienists are so kind and thorough. The best part is a gold star after your exam ⭐️

reviews.author: Cara
reviews.text:
Would you believe me if I said I kinda look forward to going to the dentist now?

Like many people, I used to dread dental appointments after a few not-so-great experiences and even delayed care because of it. ATX Family Dental completely changed that. Every team member leads with kindness, respect, and empathy. They take the time to clearly explain your care plan, answer all your questions, and never pressure you into optional or elective treatments. It’s a judgment-free zone! They manage to bring professionalism and humor into the experience, even though laughing with dental tools in your mouth can be tricky.  They all seem to genuinely enjoy their jobs and working together.. idk, It’s just a good time! I never thought I would write a review for a dental office, but here we are. Big fan. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Silas Demetriou
reviews.text:
If we’re being real…nobody likes going to the dentist. But ATX Family Dental completely changed the experience for me.

First off, the space is chic, modern, and actually feels intentional. Not sterile and cold , but stylish and welcoming. The waiting room is super cute and thoughtfully designed, which already makes you feel more relaxed walking in.

Every treatment room has a TV on the ceiling (because seriously… why do dentists put them on the wall where you can’t even see them while laying back?). And yes — they give you the remote. Full control. As they should.

They also give you these cool heart-eye sunglasses while they work on you, which is such a small but fun touch that makes everything feel less clinical and more comfortable.

Beyond the aesthetics though — the environment felt inclusive and diverse. I felt safe in more ways than one, and that matters. A lot. 🏳️‍🌈

If you’re in Austin and have been putting off a dentist visit, this might be the place that changes your mind.

reviews.author: Jonathan Caballero
reviews.text: I was referred to this office by a friend. I was initially put off by the requirement for deposit for scheduling an appointment, but once I was there it made sense. They called me a few minutes before my appointment time, and I was out at exactly the estimated time for the appointment. As someone who values punctuality, it made the deposit worth it. The office itself is designed with attention to detail. The staff are all friendly and knowledgeable. My dentist was so kind and took the opportunity to get to know me a bit and make conversation. One of the most pleasant experiences I've had at a dentist's office with the newest technology, treatments, and practices.

reviews.author: Beej
reviews.text: Had another amazing experience at ATX Family Dental! Everyone is genuinely welcoming and helpful. I saw Haley and Dr Adam today- very knowledgeable, gentle and truly my advocate for best dental health. I wouldn't go anywhere else!

reviews.author: Clint Duross
reviews.text: Well, I appreciate the professionalism of this office. I had a crown placed a little over a year ago. It was very dissatisfied with the occlusion or lack there of an over adjustment of the crown resulted and added pressure to the other side of my mouth. The office is denying that that is an issue, but has admitted that the aesthetics of the crown Are inadequate. It was significantly shorter than the tooth on the other side and it would have been possible to receive the aesthetic look while remaining structurally sound. They are now offering to redo the crown, which I already told them. I have no interest in doing because it jeopardize the overall health of my tooth. I offered them a much more inexpensive solution for them, which is to simply give me a filling in another tooth to help make things right and right now it does not seem that they are willing to do that. It’s very unfortunate. I feel my time and my money has been wasted.

reviews.author: Chloe Bates
reviews.text: This is the best practice in Austin. I’ve tried countless places and was so excited to discover this one! Beautiful lobby space, bright clean rooms, friendly staff, Netflix with headphones (a requirement for me), and excellent doctors. This is my forever dentist!

reviews.text: ATX Family Dental is outstanding! The office is vibrant, contemporary, and inviting. I've undergone extensive dental work over the years, and she is by far the most skilled dentist I have seen. I can’t recommend them highly enough!

reviews.author: Crystal Pena
reviews.text: Such a great first visit and teeth cleaning. A great place if you have any sort of dentist anxiety 🦷 Really smart and youthful staff, and good thorough overall treatment planning and care. …

reviews.author: AnnaK Beezley
reviews.text: Greatest 👍👍👍 the reassurance from staff with the British baking show on in the background is the best. All the dentists I’ve seen here over the past 5 years in two locations have been nothing but excellent …

reviews.author: JC Wingo
reviews.text: From the time you walkinto their office till you leave .The best dental officed in Austin

reviews.author: Shauna Smith
reviews.text:
I came to ATX Family Dental based on recommendations from two friends I trust.  I had my first cleaning and exam with Dr. Adam a couple of weeks ago and I went back the following week for specific work, also with Dr. Adam.  For a person who isn't easily satisfied in a dentist's office, I am highly satisfied with ATX Family Dental, so far.  My experiences both times had consistency from the front desk to the exam room.  People here make eye contact with you, communicate what to expect with clarity- from the front desk, to the waiting room, to the dental chair.  I also like that they seek further clarity with me by asking if I have questions at each transition.
The friends who recommended Dr. Adam's office know my back story.  Without sharing all the details, I had terrible dental experiences with two dentists many years ago.  I'm not proud to say it, but for 14 years, I became dentist avoidant.  Fortunately, I overcame my fears, but suffice it to say, I look for traits that go beyond framed credentials.  I'm looking for professionalism and interpersonal skills that signal the people I'm going to for my dental care are trustworthy.  That criteria will not be the same for everyone.  So far, Dr. Adam and his team are ticking all the right boxes.

reviews.author: Gloria Macias O'Brien
reviews.text: I really love the customer service and Dr. Amanda is amazing doing her work... literally magic. I will totally recommend ATX Family Dental to my friends.

reviews.text: I loved coming here. The staff was kind and made me comfortable. I have another visit coming up.

reviews.text: Always a great experience. Thank you Dr. Amanda for explaining procedures and what to expect, really calms my “dentist anxiety”. The dental techs and hygienists are always so nice and kind. Had Kaley (sorry if misspelled), dental hygienist, today and she was wonderful!

reviews.author: Alaina Hoffmann
reviews.text: A beautifully designed building full of caring and honest professionals. It is very refreshing to feel as though I can trust my dental team and feel like I’m in control of my treatment plan rather than feeling like I’m being sold unnecessary services. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Taylor Sperin
reviews.text: Wonderful office, always on time, great doctors and hygienists. I didn’t switch to my wife’s insurance because ATX Family Dental was not in policy. Did not want to lose them!

reviews.author: Brooke A Cutler
reviews.text: What a pleasant experience in their new office off south 1st street! Everyone has always been very pleasant and nice. Today was no different. Dr. Adam was great and made sure I was very comfortable for a small dental procedure that's not normally super comfortable for me. The nitrous oxide and suction mouthpiece were game changers for my overall experience. I've also really enjoyed their cinnamon essential oil treatment in the past. It's very refreshing and almost makes the dentist trip feel like a bit of a spa. The energy and music always feel very calming in the space and I appreciate that. For some of your anxious patients you should try using the weighted xray vests- super calming for the sensory system when so much is happening! Side note- they have also been super great with my highly sensitive toddler! 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Sarah Jeter
reviews.text: I’ve been going here for 8 years. Cannot speak more highly of the staff and hygienists. Very trustworthy and quality care. Best dentists in Austin, hands down!!

reviews.author: Deb Ranelle
reviews.text:
I recently went to ATX Family Dental for whitening gel and trays. My experience was excellent as the staff (Fey, Dr. Amanda, and Bethany) were professional and knowledgeable.

They listened to my concerns about sensitivity and recommended a plan to address the concerns.

Once my trays and gel came in, they were able to answer my questions around how long to use the gel, how to handle if my teeth did experience any sensitivity, and avg. time it may take for my teeth to start whitening.

The office is new, modern, and  has the latest technology. Parking is also easy as there is a good size parking lot.

Highly recommended if you’re considering or looking for a new dental office.

reviews.text: I have received excellent Dental care here. I used to be nervous all the time but everyone here is so patient and helpful. They have all you need for a pain free and comfortable visit. reviews.text: I hadn’t been to the dentist in 13 years, and had a lot of anxiety searching for one after I chipped a molar and needed to get it fixed. reviews.text: Awesome facility, staff, and general care.

reviews.author: Polli Guerrero
reviews.text:
I walked in and was greeted by several cheerful receptionists, which is saying something because my appointment was bright and early at 8am. Check in was quick, I immediately knew how much my appointment was going to cost and was able to use tap to pay.

I grabbed a free toothbrush and headed to the brushing station, the music was on and I could hear the staff happily chatting before the day began. When the staff is laughing it up with each other you really get a sense that everyone who works here is in a good groove with each other. You can tell when the staff of a place isn’t happy! The new office is stunning and clearly had a lot of thoughtful design choices because it still felt very familiar to the previous location but just fresher and bigger.

Haley was my hygienist and she was attentive as always. She is great at anticipating my needs and walking me through my appointments. I was worried about being overdue for my cleaning because I had a baby this year and just couldn’t make it in any sooner. Haley was not only non-judgmental but actually proud of me for coming in at all and sticking to my brushing and flossing routine through the new baby days. I had some questions about future elective procedures (a wisdom tooth, maybe doing Invisalign again) and never felt pressured to sign up for anything while at the same time felt really informed about my options.

I had a treatment earlier this year on some “pre cavities” and was told that it sometimes takes a few applications once a year for it to fully work. I was due for updated X-rays today so they were able to check on the spots earlier than usual and I was pleasantly shocked to learn that the treatment was already doing its job! These are spots that have been mentioned to me at previous dental offices for YEARS and never given an option to prevent them from getting worse. I have dental anxiety when it comes to injections so I jumped at the chance to avoid that when they offered the new treatment and I’m so glad I did!

Dr Adam did my exam and he is extremely thorough. He checks not only the top of your teeth but also the sides and makes sure to answer any questions you have. He will show you pictures and X-rays on a screen and then point to the spot in your mouth so you know exactly what he’s talking about. It always seems like his goal is to keep you out of his chair and just coming in for cleanings because he mostly talks about preventative measures unless there’s something that seriously needs to be addressed.

I left with a gold star (IYKYK) and clean teeth 🤩 I love my dental office!
